g.text: Kubernetes lab runtime and separate compatibility-manifest wiring
kind cluster (disposable lab; not a production dependency)
not the accepted suite's speaker connection
Service declaration does not install a proxy or listener.
No proxy sidecar is assumed in the upstream DaemonSet.
Accepted suites use managed Unix gRPC directly.
Does not own upstream BGPConfiguration, CRDs or DaemonSet.
Image fields are inert; Ready means apply succeeded.
Future EvpnGateway / EvpnVTEP / EvpnNetwork are not implemented.
Alternative integration, not the bgp_ad_handler service.
One network / one remote VTEP accepted; disabled by default.
